This project is a good introduction into password heuristics. Some suggestions to consider:
- Use enums instead of strings for password grades. You can still `impl Display` on them, so don't worry about that.
- Faster doesn't always mean better. This isn't quite a battle-tested algorithm. If you want, you could add a disclaimer on <http://crates.io|crates.io>.
- "The xyz function will never log your password" in the docstrings is unnecessary.
- In docstrings, try not referring to the function by its name. Instead, describe what it does directly, e.g. "Takes a password and outputs a grade" instead of "The grade_password function takes a..."
- Use assertions in doctests! `assert_eq!(x, 4);` is better than `println!("{x}"); // x is 4`.

Other than the movement, I liked the game idea, and the animation at the end is nice. The GUI was also clean.
I think if the movement was fixed, the maze was expanded maybe with a scrolling background with collectables, then it would be a fun and captivating game.
A Discord or Matrix bot would be very interesting as well!
